items.headline: Park Min Young and Yook Sungjae share first-day nerves in 'Nine to Six' making-of video
items.dek: The SBS romance drama's behind-the-scenes video follows its cast as they begin filming and settle into their roles.
body: Park Min Young and Yook Sungjae are taking viewers behind the scenes of their first day filming SBS romance drama “Nine to Six.” The newly released making-of video also features cast members Go Soo and Joo Hyun Young discussing their characters and the set.

Park stars as Kang Yi Ji, a workaholic who has put romance aside while concentrating on her career. When she meets the warm and thoughtful Han Sun Woo, played by Yook, she begins to open herself up to love. Their relationship unfolds as both navigate their work and personal lives.

In the video, Park talks about returning to the office drama genre and getting back into suits for the role. She also laughs about the challenges ahead, saying she expects filming to be demanding. Yook, meanwhile, says he feels nervous on set, much like Sun Woo on his first day at work.

Go Soo, who plays Park Hyun Tae, shares an upbeat first impression of the set and says he feels a good rapport with it. Joo Hyun Young, who plays Shin Ji Won, says she is still getting to know her character and expects Ji Won to feel more complete after meeting her husband and Yi Ji.
The next episode of “Nine to Six” airs November 26 at 9 p.m. KST.

items.headline: Golden Disc Awards Reveals First Performers for 2027 Hanoi Show
items.dek: TXT's Yeonjun, Yena and ZEROBASEONE are among 12 acts announced for the two-day ceremony in January.
body: The 41st Golden Disc Awards has announced its first group of performers, with TXT's Yeonjun and soloist Yena joining 10 groups on the lineup for the ceremony in Hanoi, Vietnam.

Organizer HLL revealed the artists on November 26. Alongside Yeonjun and Yena, the acts are A2O LITE, ALLDAY PROJECT, ALPHA DRIVE ONE, AND2BLE, CORTIS, Hearts2Hearts, KiiiKiii, RESCENE, TWS and ZEROBASEONE, Soompi reported.

The awards will take place on January 9 and 10, 2027, at a special outdoor stage at the Vietnam Exposition Center. Sung Si Kyung and Mun Ka Young will return as hosts after leading the previous ceremony.

Several artists are returning after wins at the 40th Golden Disc Awards. ALLDAY PROJECT received both the rookie award and a digital song bonsang, while ZEROBASEONE won an album bonsang. CORTIS took home a rookie award, KiiiKiii received the Next Generation award, and TWS won Best Performance.

For RESCENE, ALPHA DRIVE ONE, A2O LITE and Hearts2Hearts, the upcoming ceremony will mark their first Golden Disc Awards performances. ALPHA DRIVE ONE is also nominated for rookie and album bonsang awards.
Actors Ryu Seung Ryong, Kim Mu Yeol, Ji Chang Wook, Hwang In Youp and Go Youn Jung will attend as award presenters.

items.headline: Hwang Jung Min and Yum Jung Ah Reunite for Cultural Heritage Mission in ‘Mission: Cross 2’
items.dek: Netflix has released a poster and teaser for the action sequel, which premieres on December 25.
body: Hwang Jung Min and Yum Jung Ah are back in action as a married couple with a new assignment in Netflix’s “Mission: Cross 2.” The film will premiere on December 25.

The sequel follows Park Kang Mu and Mi Seon as they try to stop a mysterious organization from smuggling Korean cultural heritage artifacts out of the country. In the first film, Kang Mu was a former secret agent living as a househusband and keeping his past from Mi Seon, a violent crimes detective.

The new teaser opens with Kang Mu descending on a wire in an apron, while Mi Seon takes down opponents. After attackers steal national-treasure-level artifacts, the president, played by Cha In Pyo, gives the couple a secret mission to recover them.
The poster places the pair in front of a bronze pensive Maitreya statue and stacks of boxes, previewing the cultural heritage recovery mission at the center of the sequel.
Alongside the returning leads, the cast includes Jung Man Sik, Yoon Kyung Ho, Im Seong Jae, Cha In Pyo and Kim Guk Hee.

items.headline: Cha Seung Won and Kim Do Hoon Team Up in First Teaser for Retired Personnel Management
items.dek: The upcoming tvN drama pairs a former intelligence agent with a demoted ace whose individual skills do not guarantee smooth teamwork.
body: Cha Seung Won and Kim Do Hoon are joining forces in the first teaser for tvN's upcoming drama “Retired Personnel Management,” and their characters' partnership is off to a rocky start.

The series stars Cha as Kim Chul Soo, a former National Intelligence Service black agent who now runs a neighborhood car wash. Kim plays Go Yo Han, an elite agent who has been demoted to the Retired Personnel Management Team. The two form an alliance as they look for a fresh start.

According to Soompi, the teaser gives each character a chance to show what he can do. Chul Soo, dressed in a suit, leaves a laundromat and takes down a group approaching him. Yo Han, meanwhile, infiltrates enemy territory and faces multiple opponents in a gunfight.

Working together appears to be another matter. After a joint operation, the pair emerge with battered faces and attempt a high-five, only to miss each other's hands. Both shake their heads in frustration.
“Retired Personnel Management” premieres on January 4, 2027, at 8:45 p.m. KST. The Monday-Tuesday drama will follow “Signal Part 2.”

items.headline: Lee Sung Min and Kang Ha Neul Lead a Family Divided in ‘Ode to My Father 2’
items.dek: The sequel to the 2014 film has released its first poster and teaser ahead of a 2027 Lunar New Year theatrical release.
body: Lee Sung Min and Kang Ha Neul play a father and son navigating their differences in “Ode to My Father 2,” the upcoming sequel to the 2014 film. The production has unveiled its first poster and teaser ahead of its release during the 2027 Lunar New Year holiday.

Lee stars as Jin Man, who has spent his life working at Gukje Market and supporting his family. Kang plays his youngest son Se Joo, whose ambitions lead him away from the path his father envisioned. Their conflict and gradual understanding form the heart of the story.

The poster looks back on an earlier moment in their relationship, showing Jin Man carrying a young Se Joo on his back through a neighborhood alley. The teaser combines behind-the-scenes glimpses of the family’s daily life with the cast’s reflections on what family means to them.

Moon So Ri plays mother Ok Ryeon, while Jung Sung Il, Woo Ji Hyun and Park Jin Joo portray the couple’s other children, Dong Joo, Gi Joo and Hee Joo. Kim Geum Soon plays their aunt Sung Ja. The teaser closes with a family photo of the seven cast members.
Director Yoon Je Kyun returns from the original “Ode to My Father” to direct the sequel, which will open in theaters nationwide.

items.headline: Kim Hye Yoon Goes Undercover in New Stills for Comedy Action Film 'Teen Cop'
items.dek: The actor plays a 30-year-old detective posing as a high school student in the film, set to open in January 2027.
body: Kim Hye Yoon is heading back to the classroom in the upcoming comedy action film “Teen Cop,” with newly released stills introducing her character, detective Hui Yeon.

Hui Yeon graduated at the top of her class at the Korean National Police University, but her youthful appearance often keeps others from recognizing her skills. Under pressure to deliver results, she goes undercover as a high school student.
Her efforts to fit in include wearing pigtails and trying out slang she has quickly learned. But when a case arises, Hui Yeon shows the investigative instincts behind her disguise.

The film follows the detective and a mature-looking high school student as they become caught up in an unexpected incident. Yoon Kyung Ho plays 19-year-old student Gyu Jin, according to The Fact, while Yang Jun Ho directs the film.

To prepare for the role, Kim trained at an action school for three months, learning advanced boxing-based moves. She told Soompi that comedy action investigation was an unfamiliar genre for her, but the director gave her room to fully explore it.
“I told the director that I wanted to bring out my more easygoing side through Hui Yeon,” she said. Yoon also praised his co-star as an actor whose presence makes things positive.
“Teen Cop” is scheduled for release in theaters in January 2027.

items.headline: Soompi Highlights K-Dramas That Explore Work, Grief and Mental Health
items.dek: From the office pressures of The Ordinary Jackpot to the intertwined lives of Our Blues, the recommendations look beyond familiar drama tropes.
body: A new Soompi selection of thought-provoking K-dramas brings together stories about financial pressure, mental health and the need for human connection. Among its recommendations are workplace, ensemble and fantasy dramas that approach difficult questions from different angles.

In The Ordinary Jackpot, Lee Jun Hyuk plays Gong Eun Tae, an overworked employee who wins 1.3 billion won but decides to keep his job. With a financial safety net, he begins to deal differently with his colleagues and bosses, putting workplace power dynamics in a new light.

Our Blues takes viewers to Jeju Island, where characters at different stages of life face loneliness, family tensions and financial strain. Its ensemble includes Lee Byung Hun, Shin Min Ah, Han Ji Min and Kim Woo Bin.

Mental health is central to Daily Dose of Sunshine, starring Park Bo Young as Jung Da Eun, a nurse adapting to work in a psychiatric ward. Tomorrow approaches distress through fantasy: Rowoon plays Choi Joon Woong, who joins a team of grim reapers led by Kim Hee Sun's Goo Ryun to help prevent suicides.

My Mister centers on an unlikely understanding between engineer Park Dong Hoon, played by Lee Sun Kyun, and debt-burdened temporary employee Lee Ji An, played by IU. It's Okay to Not Be Okay also explores emotional wounds, following a psychiatric hospital caregiver, his older brother and a children's book author as they confront painful memories.

items.headline: Choi Dae Hoon Joins The Perfect Lie as Detective Investigating Min Joon Ho's Death
items.dek: The actor will make a special appearance in the MBC drama as a veteran detective assigned to the case.
body: Choi Dae Hoon is joining MBC's The Perfect Lie as the drama turns its attention to the investigation into Min Joon Ho's death. The production team announced his special appearance on November 26.

The news follows the ending of episode 8, in which Min Joon Ho, played by Yoo Yeon Seok, died. Choi will play Hwang Myung Soo, a lieutenant in the Metropolitan Investigation Unit tasked with investigating what happened.

Hwang is a homicide detective with 20 years of experience. Known for his persistence and intuition, he is also skilled at putting psychological pressure on suspects to uncover lies. His arrival adds another player to the search for the truth surrounding Min Joon Ho's death.
Newly released stills show Choi in character with a piercing gaze and a restrained expression. The serious role contrasts with his comedic performance in his previous drama, Agent Kim Reactivated.

The special appearance came about through Choi's connection with director Jo Young Min. Choi will make his first appearance in episode 9 of The Perfect Lie, which airs on November 27 at 9:50 p.m. KST.

items.headline: ATEEZ, NCT DREAM and RESCENE Lead Circle Weekly Charts
items.dek: A2O LITE also held two No. 1 spots, while ILLIT remained atop the social chart for the week of November 8 to 14.
body: ATEEZ, NCT DREAM and RESCENE each scored a No. 1 on Circle Chart's weekly rankings for November 8 to 14, while A2O LITE's debut single “NEON” continued to lead two charts.

ATEEZ's mini album “GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6” debuted at No. 1 on the physical album chart. Its POCA version appeared separately at No. 3. NCT DREAM's studio album “DREAM AFTER DREAM” entered at No. 2, with its SMC version at No. 5. LNGSHOT's EP “S.W.I.S.H.” took No. 4.

NCT DREAM also led the digital download chart with their new single “Boogie Woogie.” RESCENE's “With” followed at No. 2, while ISEGYE IDOL placed two songs in the top five: “REBELS” at No. 3 and “Love Cell” at No. 5. MEOMURU's “The Adult I Dreamed Of” rose to No. 4.
On the overall digital chart, RESCENE's “With” climbed to No. 1, ahead of A2O LITE's “NEON” and MEOMURU's track. ILLIT's “You're Under Arrest” held No. 4, and “Boogie Woogie” debuted at No. 5.

A2O LITE kept the top spot on both the streaming and global K-pop charts with “NEON.” BESTie's 2013 song “Love Options” climbed to No. 2 on the global chart, followed by ILLIT's “You're Under Arrest.”
ILLIT remained No. 1 on the social chart, with PSY and BTS at No. 2 and No. 3. A2O LITE ranked fourth, and NCT DREAM jumped 94 places to No. 5.

items.dek: The actor reprises his role with a new rank and fresh responsibilities in “New Recruit: Haunted Military Hospital,” opening December 30.
body: Nam Tae Woo is back as Choi Il Gu in new character stills for “New Recruit: Haunted Military Hospital,” bringing the familiar soldier from the “New Recruit” series to the big screen.

The film follows a group of recruits admitted to a military hospital, where their hopes of a relaxing stay give way to frightening rumors. As strange events unfold, they set out to uncover the hospital’s secrets.

Choi Il Gu returns as a newly appointed non-commissioned officer with the rank of staff sergeant, having previously been a sergeant in the series. His habit of complaining remains, but his new position also means taking care of junior soldiers while adjusting to a leadership role.

Nam said approaching the character as an officer gave him a different perspective from playing him as a soldier. He focused on showing the sincerity beneath Il Gu’s harsh words and irritation, as the character takes responsibility for more soldiers.
The film adapts the “New Recruit” series, known for its portrayal of military life. “New Recruit: Haunted Military Hospital” is set to open in theaters on December 30.

items.headline: Yoon Kyung Ho Draws on His School Days for Comedy Film ‘Teen Cop’
items.dek: The actor plays a 19-year-old student frequently mistaken for an adult in the upcoming film with Kim Hye Yoon.
body: Yoon Kyung Ho is revisiting his own school days for his role in “Teen Cop,” an upcoming comedy-action film set for release in January 2027.

New stills released by distributor NEW introduce the actor as Gyu Jin, a 19-year-old high school student whose mature appearance leads to frequent mix-ups. At a school uniform store, even the staff mistake him for a parent. Despite his imposing looks, Gyu Jin is gentle and innocent.
The film follows the student and a youthful-looking detective who become caught up in an unexpected incident. Directed by Yang Jun Ho, it stars Yoon alongside Kim Hye Yoon.

Yoon said the premise felt personal because he had been told he looked older than his age since his school days. As he prepared for the role, he studied details including rapid speech and a shy, hunched walk to capture Gyu Jin’s teenage mannerisms.

The actor told Soompi that the role was “like a gift” that let him comfort his younger self, who had lacked confidence in his appearance. He also described the film as a comedy driven by accumulating misunderstandings, with situations becoming funnier as the characters take them more seriously.
Kim, meanwhile, praised her co-star’s dedication, saying she drew energy from him on set. “Teen Cop” marks Yoon’s first film as one of two leads.

items.headline: Gong Myoung and Sung Joon Take the Mound as Friends and Rivals in 'On Your Ground'
items.dek: MBC's upcoming baseball romance follows a pitcher seeking a comeback, with new stills introducing the players and staff around him.
body: MBC has released new stills from “On Your Ground,” its upcoming romance starring Gong Myoung as a pitcher trying to return to professional baseball. The drama is set to premiere in December.

Gong Myoung plays Kang Hae Hwan, a former star whose career was interrupted by a car accident. After two years of rehabilitation, he faces the challenge of proving himself again. His path back to the field begins after he meets Seo Hee Seung, a former lawyer turned agent played by Han Hyo Joo.

At the center of the story is the Miracles, a professional club where the drama follows both the players and the people running the team. Sung Joon plays Yoon Yi Seok, a sidearm pitcher who is Hae Hwan's longtime friend and rival. While Hae Hwan was recognized as a gifted player from a young age, Yi Seok worked his way up through the minor leagues to become the team's ace.

The club's catchers also have long histories with Hae Hwan. Kim Young Sung plays Hong Seung Hyun, a defense-oriented catcher who has clashed with the pitcher before. Cheon Ju An plays Han Joo Won, Hae Hwan's personal catcher and teammate since their school days.

Away from the field, Kim Joong Ki plays general manager Oh Yoon Seok, who comes from the club's parent company and prioritizes business efficiency and results. Jung Soon Won plays operations team leader Kim Do Shik, a former Miracles infielder who helps navigate issues between the players and the front office.
Alongside Hae Hwan's comeback and relationships with his teammates, “On Your Ground” will explore club decisions that affect players' careers and the challenges they face as baseball changes.

items.dek: BTS, IVE and aespa are among the artists nominated as the awards prepare to take place in Hanoi on January 9 and 10, 2027.
body: The 41st Golden Disc Awards has announced its nominees for the digital song and album main awards, as well as Rookie Artist of the Year, ahead of its January ceremony in Hanoi, Vietnam.

According to Soompi, songs and albums released from early November 2025 through late October 2026 were eligible for consideration. Organizer HLL said nominees were selected using measures including digital music usage and album sales.

The Digital Song Division and Album Division each have 20 nominees. BTS, IVE and aespa appear in both categories, alongside Hearts2Hearts, NMIXX and Taeyeon on the digital song list and Stray Kids, ENHYPEN and SEVENTEEN members JEONGHAN X JOSHUA on the album list.
The rookie category has 15 nominees, selected using combined digital usage and album sales. ALPHA DRIVE ONE is nominated for both Rookie Artist of the Year and the album main award.

Sung Si Kyung and Mun Ka Young will host the ceremony on January 9 and 10, 2027, at a special outdoor stage at the Vietnam Exposition Center. Actors Ryu Seung Ryong, Kim Mu Yeol, Ji Chang Wook, Hwang In Yeop and Go Youn Jung are set to attend as presenters.

items.headline: ILLIT’s ‘BREAK EVEN’ Marks Third Week on Billboard 200
items.dek: The mini album is ILLIT’s first to spend three weeks on the Billboard 200, following its top 10 debut.
body: ILLIT’s “BREAK EVEN” has become the group’s first album to spend three weeks on the Billboard 200.

As Soompi reported, Billboard revealed on November 24 local time that the mini album ranked No. 153 in its third consecutive week on the chart. It debuted at No. 6 earlier in the month, giving ILLIT their first top 10 entry on the albums chart.
“BREAK EVEN” also placed No. 5 on Billboard’s World Albums chart and No. 16 on the Top Album Sales chart that week.
The mini album’s title track, “You’re Under Arrest,” appeared on two of Billboard’s global song charts for a fourth week. It ranked No. 35 on the Global Excl. U.S. chart and No. 48 on the Global 200.
ILLIT’s previous title track, “It’s Me,” continued its run on the Global Excl. U.S. chart, placing No. 179 in its 29th week.

items.headline: Kim You Jung Leads November Actor Brand Reputation Rankings
items.dek: The 100 Days of Deception cast claimed three of the top four spots in the Korean Business Research Institute's November rankings.
body: Kim You Jung topped the November actor brand reputation rankings, with her 100 Days of Deception co-star, GOT7's Park Jinyoung, taking second place.

The Korean Business Research Institute gave Kim an index of 5,857,724, while Park followed with 5,414,725. Fellow 100 Days of Deception actor Kim Hyun Joo placed fourth, putting three cast members in the top four.
Shin Min Ah ranked third with an index of 3,204,375. Kim Hyun Joo earned 3,029,621, and Go Youn Jung completed the top five with 2,920,048.

As Soompi reported, the institute assessed 100 actors who appeared in dramas, films or streaming content released between October 24 and November 24. Its analysis considered media coverage, participation, interaction and community indexes.
Kim You Jung can also be seen in the drama Dear X, while Park Jinyoung appears in the film Hi-Five. Shin Min Ah stars in the film The Eyes.

body: ATEEZ have claimed four No. 1 spots on Billboard's charts with their latest release, as title track "UP" made its debut on the Hot 100.

The group's mini album "GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6" opened at No. 1 on the Billboard 200, Top Album Sales and World Albums charts, Soompi reported. ATEEZ also returned to the top of the Artist 100, which ranks artists across genres using measures including sales, radio airplay and streaming.

The Billboard 200 result makes ATEEZ the K-pop group with the most top 10 albums on the chart to date. The mini album's Top Album Sales debut also means it was the week's best-selling album in the United States.

"UP" entered the Hot 100 at No. 90, giving ATEEZ their third appearance on the chart, which ranks the most popular songs in the United States. The group's previous entries were "Lemon Drop" and "In Your Fantasy."
Together, the chart results mark a strong showing for both the mini album and its lead single, with ATEEZ placing at the top of Billboard's artist ranking as well as three album charts.

items.headline: Real comedians helped shape the sketches in tvN drama 'Happy Anding'
items.dek: The production team studied live comedy and worked with comedians to bring fictional trio Asura's performances to the screen.
body: The team behind tvN's coming-of-age drama “Happy Anding” turned to working comedians for help creating its onstage sketches and shaping the world of its fictional comedy trio, Asura.

Kang Hoon, Cho Hyun Chul and Kim Jung Jin play Kang Tae Gu, Kim Nam Il and Han Jun Seo, three comedians who have spent a decade trying to make a name for themselves. After meeting a mysterious woman, they begin looking for new ways forward.

Based on the Japanese NTV series “Life's Punchline,” the drama keeps the original's focus on the value of pursuing a dream, rather than judging that effort solely by its outcome. The production team told Soompi that it wanted to share the message that experiences people dismiss as meaningless can still matter.

To adapt the story for Korean viewers, the team interviewed comedians and observed how live performers revised material, met after shows and developed a rhythm with their audiences. The creators said their subjects' love of being onstage became central to their portrayal of Asura.

Staff from “Gag Concert” and the former Yoon Hyung Bin Small Theater helped the team observe the process from backstage preparation through performance. Comedian Song Pil Geun joined during planning, helped create the drama's sketches and assisted with acting rehearsals. Song and Yoo Jae Phil were among the comedians who also coached performances on set.
Song praised the three actors' commitment to portraying an unusual profession and said the drama moved him to tears during episodes 1, 3 and 4.

body: Ji Young Yoo is trading medical school for a shot at the stage in the first trailer for K-Pop: The Debut, an upcoming film about a global competition to form a K-pop girl group.

Yoo plays Lizzy, a Korean American woman who heads to Seoul after earning a place in the televised audition. She faces contestants from around the world as they compete for four debut spots. Eric Nam plays an unexpected ally who helps Lizzy gain confidence along the way.

The trailer shows that Lizzy's path is far from easy. After placing last in the first mission, she continues through practice sessions and competition rounds, gradually finding her own style. It also offers a look at performances by the other contestants.
According to Soompi, BTS member Jin's solo song Epiphany appears as Lizzy's audition song. The film will also feature music by artists including BTS, IVE, aespa, TWICE and LE SSERAFIM.

SEVENTEEN's Joshua, ENHYPEN's Jay and Jake, KATSEYE, Hwasa, Sandara Park, ILLIT and Tablo are among the artists set to make cameo appearances. The cast also includes Yoo Ji Tae, Tony Revolori, Yim Si Wan, Sung Joon and Kang Sora.

Directed by Benson Lee and produced by HYBE America, K-Pop: The Debut is set for a theatrical release in February 2027. Yoo, who voiced Zoey in KPop Demon Hunters, sings and dances as well as acts in the film.

items.headline: Viki Adds More K-Dramas for Viewers in Southeast Asia
items.dek: The expanded selection includes crime thriller Signal, romance Touch Your Heart and historical drama The Crowned Clown.
body: Viki has made more Korean dramas available to stream in Southeast Asia, with a lineup spanning romance, crime, fantasy and historical drama, Soompi reports. The selection follows an earlier release of classic K-dramas on the platform in the region.

Crime fans can find Signal, starring Lee Je Hoon as a profiler who uses a mysterious walkie-talkie to connect with a detective in the past, played by Cho Jin Woong. Kim Hye Soo also stars as a veteran detective working on cold cases. In Remember You, Jang Nara plays a detective investigating a serial killer alongside a criminal profiler played by Seo In Guk.

The romance selection includes It's Okay, That's Love, in which Kong Hyo Jin's psychiatrist unexpectedly shares a home with Zo In Sung's novelist. Because This Is My First Life brings Jung So Min and Lee Min Ki together as a struggling writer and her socially awkward landlord.

Touch Your Heart stars Yoo In Na as an actress who takes a job with Lee Dong Wook's lawyer to prepare for a role. Cheese in the Trap follows Kim Go Eun as a student whose life changes after she receives a scholarship intended for an upperclassman played by Park Hae Jin.

Viewers looking for fantasy can try Bring it On, Ghost, starring Taecyeon and Kim So Hyun as an exorcist and a ghost who team up. In The Crowned Clown, Yeo Jin Goo plays both a threatened king and the lookalike brought in to protect him.
Other titles in the selection include Save Me, Lawless Lawyer, Familiar Wife and Hundred Million Stars From the Sky.

The series follows seven people drawn into a kidnapping case unfolding across Seoul, Tokyo, Taipei, Singapore, Bangkok, Naha and Manila. Each is assigned a different mission in a survival game that puts their loved ones at risk.

Han has also worked with Niide Toshiro, played by Sakaguchi Kentaro, to narrow down clues in the case. In Taipei, he recalled his connection to Christina Lin, played by Alice Ko, and discovered a link to Tokyo five years earlier.

body: A lunch date brings an unwelcome surprise for Oh Se Young and Lee Jung Shin's characters in new stills from “What a Boss Wants.” Sung Hoon's Kwon Do Hyuk follows the pair after overhearing their phone conversation, setting the stage for a tense encounter.

The MBN romance, based on a web novel, stars Sung Hoon as Do Hyuk, a chaebol boss with no sense of taste who searches for a woman whose voice he heard on an album. Oh Se Young plays Lee Eun Chae, an indie band's lead vocalist, while Lee Jung Shin plays Moon Tae Kyung.

As Soompi reported, Do Hyuk looks uncomfortable when Eun Chae gives Tae Kyung a thank-you gift and receives a bright smile in return. Eun Chae and Do Hyuk are already in the middle of a bet over whether she will fall for him during their contract period.

Do Hyuk later takes Eun Chae to a resort in Gangwon Province. After shopping and eating together, they sit in camping chairs with beer under the night sky. When Do Hyuk falls asleep, Eun Chae reaches toward him as she watches him.

Tae Kyung, meanwhile, has promised to protect Eun Chae's secret that she performs as indie band vocalist Soo. He suggests that she sing at a Seheon Hospital charity event and gives her a bouquet after the performance, leaving her visibly delighted.

Based on a webtoon of the same name, the sports drama follows Jung Min Yong, a former professional baseball pitching coach played by Kim. After an unexpected accident gives him a special ability, he becomes head coach of the high school team ranked last in the nation.

Kim's character takes center stage in the poster, looking seriously toward the field. Around him are scenes of Dukchun High's players in action, Seo as team manager Yoon Seo Jin, and parents cheering from the sidelines.

The images show the team celebrating and encouraging one another, as well as finding the strength to rise after setbacks. body: MBC's upcoming drama “On Your Ground” is looking back at the first love that connects its two leads, played as adults by Han Hyo Joo and Gong Myoung.

The romance follows baseball player Kang Hae Hwan, whose career stalls after a setback, and Seo Hee Seung, a former lawyer who becomes an agent. Their reunion puts Hae Hwan, played by Gong Myoung, on a path toward returning to the field.

Newly released stills introduce Jeon So Young and Yoo Ji Hoon as the teenage Hee Seung and Hae Hwan. In the images, she wears a school uniform while he appears in his baseball jersey, capturing the early days of their relationship.

The pair first meet by chance 11 years before the drama's present-day story. Hee Seung is the top student at their high school, while Hae Hwan is a gifted baseball player. A note brings them together, and their connection grows into a first love before they part ways.

When they meet again as adults, Hee Seung has left her career as a lawyer at a major law firm to become an agent. Hae Hwan, meanwhile, is a talented pitcher in a deep slump. The production team praised the resemblance between the younger and older actors, as well as the continuity in their expressions and chemistry.
“On Your Ground” is set to premiere on MBC in December.

In one image, she surveys the ward while holding a medical chart. Another captures her looking intently at something in a dark space. Her character is described as calm and composed, but she also takes action when strange rumors begin to circulate.
“She is someone who does not simply encounter strange rumors but takes steps to resolve the issues surrounding them,” Jeongyeon said, according to Soompi.

The film follows recruits admitted to a military hospital, where their hopes for a restful stay give way to unsettling rumors. As they investigate, they try to uncover the hospital's secrets. It is an adaptation of the series “New Recruit.”

To prepare for the unfamiliar role, Jeongyeon watched documentaries about military nurse officers. She studied details of their daily routines, including how they wear their uniforms, walk and carry a notebook and pen.

Director Min Jin Ki praised her portrayal and the energy she brought to her interactions with the other actors, saying he was “150 percent satisfied” with her performance. The film opens in theaters on December 30.

body: The first teaser for “Signal Part 2” has arrived, offering a glimpse of the crime drama’s return ahead of its December 7 premiere.

Released on November 23 alongside a new poster, the roughly 40-second video moves through images and phrases connected to the past, the present and criminal cases. The poster places an old walkie-talkie against a dark background, echoing the device at the heart of the original series.

The 2016 drama “Signal” followed detectives in different time periods who communicated by walkie-talkie as they worked on long-unsolved cases. Kim Hye Soo, Lee Je Hoon and Cho Jin Woong return for the sequel, which is written by Kim Eun Hee.

The sequel’s release had been delayed amid controversy over Cho’s past juvenile criminal record. The actor acknowledged wrongdoing as a minor and announced his retirement from entertainment. Broadcaster tvN later confirmed the drama’s release, saying the decision did not mean it was defending or justifying the issue and that it had also considered the work of the other actors and crew.
“Signal Part 2” will run for eight episodes. The first two will air back-to-back on December 7, beginning at 10 p.m. KST, followed by the third episode on December 8.

body: MBC's upcoming drama “On Your Ground” has released stills introducing six characters from the legal and sports agency worlds surrounding Han Hyo Joo's Seo Hee Seung, Soompi reports.

The romance follows baseball player Kang Hae Hwan, played by Gong Myoung, whose career stops after a setback. He begins working toward a return to the field after meeting Hee Seung, a former lawyer who has become an agent.

At Law Firm Joy, where Hee Seung previously worked, Cho Han Cheul plays managing partner Jo Gu Yeon. A longtime baseball fan, Gu Yeon wants to expand the firm his father founded into sports representation, with Hee Seung at the forefront of the move.

Kwon Seung Woo plays Park Do Ha, a lawyer who knew Hee Seung at university and attended law school with her. Unlike Gu Yeon, Do Ha is a supportive ally who sees his hardworking junior without prejudice.

The stills also introduce four members of Donghaeng, the sports agency where Hee Seung starts a new chapter. Hong Woo Jin plays Choi Moo Sung, a former national team infielder who is now an agent team leader and a trusted partner to Dong Chi Young, played by Kim Shin Rock.

Lee Je Yeon takes the role of Park Joo Hyun, a former securities worker who values players' profitability and marketability and hopes to establish his own agency. Oh Kyung Joo plays baseball enthusiast Yoon Sung Hoon, whose boastful but innocent personality leads to playful exchanges with Joo Hyun.

Oh Yu Jin rounds out the group as Chae Dong Won, the agency's data analysis team head. A science and engineering graduate recruited by Chi Young, Dong Won once disliked baseball because of her father's obsession with the sport.
The production team said the contrast between the differing goals at Joy and the teamwork at Donghaeng will be a point to watch. “On Your Ground” is scheduled to premiere in December.

items.headline: Lee Dong Geon and Lim Young Min Introduce Their Characters in Wintertime Script Reading Video
items.dek: The upcoming BL drama follows two men who reunite after nine years with unresolved feelings between them.
body: Lee Dong Geon and Lim Young Min have offered a first look at their characters in a new script reading video for Wintertime, an upcoming BL drama premiering November 27.

Based on a web novel of the same name, Wintertime follows Gu Seung Hyuk and Kwon Yi Hyun as they meet again after nine years apart. Their reunion draws them back into a relationship shaped by old wounds, resentment and lingering affection.
The video shows the leads reading scenes together, as well as discussing their characters, their reasons for joining the project and their impressions of the reading, Soompi reported.

Lee, who plays Seung Hyuk, described him as outwardly cold but passionate beneath the surface. He said he recognized similarities between himself and the character, particularly in their bluntness and difficulty expressing emotions.
Lim plays Yi Hyun, a character he said conceals many of his feelings and requires a subtle performance. He was drawn to the project by the chance to grow while portraying those emotions.

After the reading, Lee praised his fellow actors and said their performances made him feel he needed to do well too. Lim said he had been nervous about his first script reading and came away determined to work harder when filming began. The drama marks Lim's first drama acting role, according to a report carried by Naver.

Based on a webtoon, the drama stars Joy as Gong Yu Il, a job seeker who unexpectedly becomes the manager of top star Tak Mu I, played by Kim Hyun Jin. Behind his fame, Mu I carries emotional scars from a stalking incident.

As Soompi reported, Mu I learns that Yu Il wrote his cherished novel, Star and Half Moon. The book helped him find the courage to face the world again after a difficult slump, making the discovery especially meaningful to him.

Yu Il, meanwhile, begins to develop feelings of her own as their paths continue to cross. While working as an extra at the request of her friend and drama producer Yoo Yeon Joo, played by Na Hyun Young, she sees Mu I filming an arcade date scene with actress Ju Da Hong, played by Kang Na Eon.

They meet again when Yu Il joins restaurant owner and chef Kang Hee Soo, played by Shin Hyun Soo, on a coffee truck delivery to Mu I's filming location. Mu I is openly happy to see her and shows her attention, leaving Yu Il increasingly flustered.

items.headline: ATEEZ Earns Fourth Billboard 200 No. 1 With 'GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6'
items.dek: The mini album gives ATEEZ its 10th consecutive top 10 on the U.S. chart, the most for any group in the 2020s.
body: ATEEZ has landed its fourth No. 1 on the Billboard 200 as “GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6” debuts atop the chart dated November 28.

The mini album earned 195,000 equivalent album units in the United States in the week ending November 19, according to Luminate data reported by Billboard. Traditional album sales accounted for 191,000 of that total, while streaming contributed 4,000 units.
Soompi reported that the release is ATEEZ's 10th consecutive top 10 album on the Billboard 200. The streak began in 2022 with “THE WORLD EP.1 : MOVEMENT,” which reached No. 3.

The latest entry puts ATEEZ alone among groups for the most Billboard 200 top 10 albums in the 2020s. The group had previously been tied with Stray Kids at nine, according to Billboard. Across all acts, YoungBoy Never Broke Again has 15 top 10s this decade and Taylor Swift has 14.
ATEEZ's previous Billboard 200 No. 1 albums are “THE WORLD EP.FIN : WILL,” “GOLDEN HOUR : Part.2” and “GOLDEN HOUR : Part.5.”

“GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6” also debuts at No. 1 on Billboard's Top Album Sales chart. Billboard reported that the album was available in 32 CD and vinyl variants, including signed editions, with collectible items such as photocards and posters.

body: P1Harmony has opened at No. 1 on Billboard’s World Albums chart with its new mini album “BLOW UP,” leading a chart that also features multiple releases from Stray Kids, BTS and CORTIS.

On the chart for the week ending November 21, “BLOW UP” also became P1Harmony’s first No. 1 on Top Album Sales. It debuted at No. 4 on the Billboard 200, matching the group’s highest position on that chart.
ILLIT’s “BREAK EVEN” held at No. 2 on World Albums in its third week. The release also became the group’s first album to spend more than one week on the Billboard 200.
Stray Kids placed four albums on World Albums, led by “THIS & THAT” at No. 3 in its 14th week. “KARMA” stayed at No. 7, while “DO IT” rose to No. 15 and “ATE” climbed to No. 21.

CORTIS’s “GREENGREEN” remained at No. 4, with ENHYPEN’s “THE SIN : BLISS” holding at No. 5. xikers’ new mini album “ROUTE ZERO : The CALLING” debuted at No. 6, and IVE’s “Looks Can Kill” ranked No. 8.

body: IU has announced the first dates for her 2027 world tour, starting with two concerts in Bangkok on January 16 and 17. The initial schedule runs through May and includes stops across Asia and Australia.
According to Soompi, the tour was officially announced at midnight KST on November 23. More cities and dates will be revealed for fans outside the first group of stops.
After Bangkok, IU will head to Bulacan on January 30 and 31, followed by Kaohsiung on February 13 and 14. She will then perform in Sydney on February 27.

The March schedule includes two nights in Singapore on March 6 and 7 and two in Kuala Lumpur on March 27 and 28. In April, IU will visit Tokyo on April 7 and 8, Taipei on April 17 and 18, and Hong Kong on April 24 and 25.
The final stop on the initial schedule is Jakarta, where she is set to perform on May 8 and 9.

items.headline: &TEAM earns Circle million certification as Stray Kids and CLOSE YOUR EYES go double platinum
items.dek: Circle Chart's latest certifications recognize albums by BOYNEXTDOOR, LE SSERAFIM and others, as well as a streaming milestone for Roy Kim.
body: &TEAM's Korean mini album "Mark on Me" has earned a million certification from Circle Chart after selling more than 1 million copies, Soompi reported.

Stray Kids and CLOSE YOUR EYES also reached major sales milestones. The FANS version of Stray Kids' "THIS & THAT" and the EVER version of CLOSE YOUR EYES' "256th Note" each received double platinum certification, recognizing sales of more than 500,000 copies apiece.
BOYNEXTDOOR picked up two platinum certifications for "HOME: DELUXE." Both the regular and Weverse versions of the repackaged album sold more than 250,000 copies each.
The latest platinum album recipients also include CRAVITY's "sonorous," LE SSERAFIM's "Made My Night," CORTIS' "GREENGREEN_playextended," EVAN (Heeseung)'s "DEATH OF ME" and Young Tak's "GOGO."
Roy Kim joined the latest list in the streaming category. His 2024 song "If You Ask Me What Love Is" was certified platinum after surpassing 100 million streams.

The Korea Music Content Industry Association introduced the certification system in 2018 for album sales, downloads and streaming. Under the system, albums released from January 1, 2018 are eligible for platinum certification at 250,000 sales and million certification at 1 million sales.

items.headline: Six K-Dramas Where Female Doctors Lead the Story
items.dek: From tense surgical thrillers to stories of career reinvention, these dramas put women in medicine at the center.
body: K-drama doctors face more than emergencies in the operating room. In a selection highlighted by Soompi, female physicians also confront hospital politics, career setbacks and difficult relationships.

In "Doctor X," Kim Ji Won plays Gye Soo Jung, a gifted surgeon who challenges corruption at a hospital where power and money often come before patients. Her independent approach puts her at odds with the institution around her.

"Dr. Romantic" follows the doctors mentored by surgeon Teacher Kim, played by Han Suk Kyu, at a provincial hospital. Seo Hyun Jin portrays surgeon Yoon Seo Jung in the first season, while Lee Sung Kyung appears in later seasons as Cha Eun Jae, a cardiothoracic surgeon who struggles with anxiety in the operating room.

For a mix of medicine and romance, "Descendants of the Sun" sends Song Hye Kyo's surgeon Kang Mo Yeon to the fictional war-torn region of Uruk with a medical team. Kim Ji Won also stars as army surgeon Yoon Myung Joo.

"Hyper Knife" takes a darker route. Park Eun Bin plays Jung Se Ok, a former neurosurgical prodigy who works in an illegal operating facility after a falling out with her mentor, Choi Deok Hee, played by Sul Kyung Gu. Their eventual reunion brings their fraught history back into focus.
In "Doctors," Park Shin Hye's Yoo Hye Jung finds a new direction after meeting a former doctor turned teacher, Hong Ji Hong, played by Kim Rae Won. She goes on to become a neurosurgeon.

"Doctor Cha" follows another path back to medicine. Uhm Jung Hwa plays Cha Jeong Suk, who resumes her residency after two decades as a housewife, balancing the demands of hospital training with upheaval in her marriage.

body: BTS, CORTIS and BIGBANG were among the winners as the 2026 MAMA Awards wrapped up at Kyocera Dome Osaka on November 21.

BTS received Album of the Year for “ARIRANG,” while CORTIS claimed Song of the Year for “REDRED.” BIGBANG was named Music Visionary of the Year and also won Best Music Video for “BiiiG,” according to Soompi’s Chapter 2 winners report.

Across the two-day ceremony, BTS also won Artist of the Year and Best Male Group, bringing its total to five awards. The group did not attend because of its tour schedule, Newsen reported. ENHYPEN received the other grand prize, Fans’ Choice of the Year, on the first night.

CORTIS picked up four awards over the event, including Best Dance Performance Male Group for “REDRED.” ILLIT won Best Dance Performance Female Group for “It’s Me,” and LE SSERAFIM took Best Collaboration for “SPAGHETTI,” featuring BTS member j-hope.
The Best Song Top 10 selections included “REDRED,” “It’s Me” and “SPAGHETTI,” as well as tracks by aespa, BTS, IVE, I.O.I, Hearts2Hearts, NMIXX and Hwasa.

Hwasa also won Best Vocal Performance Solo for “Good Goodbye.” Taeyang and Yena took the male and female solo dance performance awards, respectively, while ATEEZ won Best Choreography for “BAD.” AKMU received Best Vocal Performance Group, JANNABI won Best Band Performance, and ZEROBASEONE was named Favorite Dance & Vocal Performance Group.

items.headline: Ju Ji Hoon's K-Drama Roles Span Royal Romance, Zombies and Legal Rivalry
items.dek: A Soompi watchlist highlights the actor's range, from a Joseon crown prince in Kingdom to a lawyer facing off against Kim Hye Soo in Hyena.
body: Ju Ji Hoon has played royalty, a surgeon and a rookie ranger, but his characters' challenges are rarely straightforward. A new Soompi watchlist revisits his K-drama roles, offering fans several places to start depending on their preferred genre.

In Kingdom, Ju plays Joseon crown prince Lee Chang, whose search for answers about his father's illness leads him to physician Seo Bi, played by Bae Doona. Their paths cross as a zombie outbreak spreads across the country.

Hyena puts him in a very different kind of contest. His character, elite law firm attorney Yoon Hee Jae, falls for fellow lawyer Jung Geum Ja, played by Kim Hye Soo, unaware that their relationship is part of her plan. Despite their differences, a case eventually brings them together professionally.

For viewers who prefer palace romance, one of Ju's earliest leading roles casts him as Lee Shin, a royal who enters an arranged marriage with high school student Shin Chae Kyung, played by Yoon Eun Hye. His initially cold attitude begins to shift as he develops feelings for her.

His other roles include trauma surgeon Baek Kang Hyuk, who takes charge of a struggling university hospital team, and rookie ranger Kang Hyun Jo, who partners with Jun Ji Hyun's Seo Yi Kang. Ju also plays Emperor Sovieshu opposite Shin Min Ah's Empress Navier, whose marriage is shaken when he takes a mistress and asks for a divorce.

The show brought together LNGSHOT, MODYSSEY and TUIDE for "That That." Each act also performed separately, with LNGSHOT presenting "Bananas," MODYSSEY performing "HOOK" and "CAN YOU HEAR THAT," and TUIDE taking on "SUN KISS."

Panic joined Kim Tae Rae of ZEROBASEONE, Woochan of ALLDAY PROJECT, Yuha of Hearts2Hearts and WOODZ for "The Sea in My Old Drawer." Panic also performed "Left-Handed" with CORTIS members Martin and Seonghyeon.

items.dek: BTS won Artist of the Year and ENHYPEN received Fans' Choice of the Year as the two-day ceremony opened in Osaka.
body: BTS and ENHYPEN were among the top winners at Chapter 1 of the 2026 MAMA Awards, held November 20 at Kyocera Dome Osaka. BTS received Artist of the Year, while ENHYPEN won Fans' Choice of the Year.

ENHYPEN's win marked the group's second consecutive year receiving a MAMA grand prize. The members became emotional onstage as they thanked their fans, known as ENGENE. Leader Jungwon credited fans with believing in the group during a difficult year.

BTS accepted their award by video while on tour in Kaohsiung, Taiwan. The group noted that the win came 10 years after their first MAMA grand prize. J-Hope thanked ARMY for helping BTS move forward despite the responsibility that comes with such awards.

ENHYPEN also won Favorite M Countdown Stage and appeared on the Fans' Choice Male Top 10 list alongside TREASURE, CORTIS, LNGSHOT, BIGBANG, BTS, EVAN, SEVENTEEN, Stray Kids and TXT. ZEROBASEONE received Worldwide KCONers' Choice.
The Fans' Choice Female Top 10 winners were ILLIT, TUIDE, BABYMONSTER, Hearts2Hearts, Apink, i-dle, LE SSERAFIM, NMIXX, TWICE and Lim Yoona.
Other Chapter 1 winners included ALPHA DRIVE ONE and TUIDE for Best New Artist, IVE for Best Female Group and RESCENE for Best of Next. The MAMA Awards continue with a second day on November 21.

body: Kim Woo Bin is stepping onto a high school baseball field with a new advantage and a team he is not sure he can trust. A highlight teaser for tvN's upcoming drama "GIFT" introduces his character, Jung Min Yong, as he takes charge of Duckchun High School's last-place baseball team.

Based on a webtoon, the sports drama follows the former professional pitching coach after an incident earns him a reputation for verbal abuse and leaves him facing possible dismissal from the pro game. A serious car accident then brings him close to death, changes his personality and gives him the ability to see players' abilities.

Jung plans to use his newfound skill to get results at Duckchun, but the teaser shows him dismissing the players already on the team. His skepticism sets up a clash with students who are determined to keep playing despite their low ranking.

The preview also contrasts the coach's stern approach with the team's playful energy, showing the students joking around and running through school hallways. Jung challenges them to show him their best, even as he can see their limits.
"GIFT" premieres December 5 at 9:10 p.m. KST on tvN.

items.headline: Jang Nara and Kim Hye Yoon Face Off in First 'Good Partner 2' Courtroom Preview
items.dek: The first-episode clip pits the two lawyers against each other in a divorce case ahead of the drama's November 20 premiere.
body: Jang Nara and Kim Hye Yoon are already on opposing sides in a new preview of "Good Partner 2." Released ahead of the premiere, the clip shows their characters clashing over how to interpret an agreement between a divorcing couple.

Jang returns as star divorce lawyer Cha Eun Kyung, while Kim plays Kang Hye Sung, an experienced attorney who takes divorce cases seriously. The new season follows the two as they become each other's "good partner." P.O also reprises his role as Jeon Eun Ho, who has become a more seasoned lawyer.

In the courtroom preview, Kang argues that the opposing side is making a subjective interpretation of a clause about not interfering in each other's private lives or outside relationships. Cha counters that the wording naturally supports her reading.

Initially caught off guard, Kang recalls Cha's earlier advice to set emotions aside and challenge the central argument. She asks whether private life and sex life are synonymous, a response that briefly impresses Cha.
But Cha quickly pushes back, citing legal precedent concerning affairs in divorce cases and telling Kang to focus on the actual issue. Kang is left struggling for a reply.
According to Soompi, "Good Partner 2" premieres November 20 at 9:50 p.m. KST and will be available on Viki.

body: Ahn Bo Hyun and Lee Sung Min face a perilous mission in the main poster for JTBC's upcoming historical drama "Sacred Jewel," which premieres December 5 at 10:40 p.m. KST.

Set in 1258, the drama follows an expedition searching for the Avalokitesvara Bead, a sacred relic believed to have the power to protect Goryeo. With the kingdom close to defeat after about 30 years of war with Mongolia, a princess also heads to the battlefield to save the unit.

Ahn takes the central position in the poster as Baek Gyeol, who is appointed to lead the expedition by the emperor's decree. Beside him are Lee Sung Min as Yabyeolcho captain Choi Gu and Ha Yun Kyung as the guide Geol Seung. The three bear marks of battle as they look ahead.

Claudia Kim appears as Princess Gyeonghwa, Wang Hee, while Yoon Kyun Sang plays the armored defense inspector Wang Mu. A message on the poster points the team toward the eastern end of the country, where Goryeo's last hope lies.
The series will air on JTBC, with replay viewing available exclusively on Coupang Play and a global release through Amazon Prime.

Hive Media Corp announced the casting on November 20, Soompi reported. Song will play Il Bong, a villager living deep in the mountains of Pyeongan Province. After accidentally capturing a Japanese deserter, Il Bong sees a chance to change his fortunes.

Lee Seok Hoon, whose directing credits include “The Pirates,” “The Himalayas” and “Confidential Assignment 2: International,” will direct the film. It marks his first collaboration with Song, according to TenAsia.

The project also reunites Song with Hive Media Corp, which produced his upcoming film “Gardeners.” Hive Media Corp CEO Kim Won Guk said he was excited to work with the actor again, describing “Heokgaebi” as a story with a creative premise and distinctive characters.

As Soompi reports, the teaser follows participants looking for romantic connections while taking an active interest in their siblings' love lives. body: Sung Joon is stepping onto the baseball field in MBC's upcoming drama “On Your Ground,” with new stills offering a first look at his character, Yoon Yi Seok.

The actor plays a sidearm pitcher and ace for the professional team Miracles. Yoon Yi Seok has known Kang Hae Hwan, played by Gong Myoung, since high school, when the two shared the dream of becoming baseball players. Their paths to the sport, however, have been very different.

While Kang Hae Hwan attracted attention for his talent from an early age, Yoon Yi Seok spent years working through difficulties in the minor leagues. He kept developing his skills and eventually became his team's leading pitcher.

That history leaves Yoon Yi Seok with mixed feelings about his old friend. He cares for Kang Hae Hwan but also wants to beat him on the field, a tension that could reshape their relationship when Kang Hae Hwan attempts to return to baseball.

The drama follows Kang Hae Hwan after a setback stops his career. He begins working toward a comeback after meeting Seo Hee Seung, a former lawyer who has become a sports agent, played by Han Hyo Joo.

body: Physical: Asia is coming back for a second season in 2027, Netflix has confirmed. Titled Physical: Asia 2 - Unbroken, the new installment will continue the competition between athletes representing Asian countries.

The first season premiered in October 2025 as the Physical franchise's first international team competition. Its challenges drew on aspects of Korean and other Asian cultures, while putting competitors' teamwork and strategy to the test.

Season 2 will introduce new athletes, quests and matchups. Producer Jang Ho-gi said the team has designed a different setting from previous installments and developed challenges intended to become new signatures of the series.
Jang also said the producers hope to showcase strategies and outcomes distinctive to a competition between nations, rather than simply making the show bigger.

The renewal comes as the Physical franchise expands internationally. Local versions in Mexico and Italy each spent two consecutive weeks in Netflix's Global Top 10 after their releases, according to the streamer. Versions for the United States, France and Sweden are also in the works, while Physical: 100: Mexico has been renewed for a second season.

items.headline: &TEAM and BOYNEXTDOOR Earn Platinum Album Certifications in Japan
items.dek: &TEAM's "Mark on Me" received double platinum certification from the RIAJ, while BOYNEXTDOOR's "The Action" went platinum.
body: &TEAM and BOYNEXTDOOR have picked up new Recording Industry Association of Japan certifications for their Korean mini albums.

As reported by Soompi, &TEAM's "Mark on Me" was certified double platinum after shipping more than 500,000 units in Japan. BOYNEXTDOOR's "The Action" received a platinum certification for shipments of more than 250,000 units.
The two releases were included in the RIAJ's latest batch of official certifications. Under the association's thresholds, an album qualifies for gold at 100,000 units shipped and platinum at 250,000.

The RIAJ awards its gold disc certifications based on cumulative net shipments since a release's launch, following applications from member companies. The association generally announces each month's certified titles on the 10th of the following month.
Both certified releases are Korean-language mini albums, with &TEAM reaching the double platinum tier and BOYNEXTDOOR reaching platinum in the Japanese market.

body: A2O LITE’s “NEON” claimed three No. 1 spots on Circle’s October charts, leading the overall digital, streaming and global K-pop rankings, Soompi reported. The debut single also topped those three categories on the weekly charts for a third consecutive week.

On the monthly album chart, NCT WISH entered at No. 1 with the mini album “I SPY.” PLAVE’s “HYPERDRIVE” followed at No. 2, while SEVENTEEN unit JxJ’s debut mini album “DREAMSCAPE” came in third. IVE’s “Looks Can Kill” and ILLIT’s “BREAK EVEN” completed the top five.

RESCENE made a strong showing across the song rankings. The group took all five top spots on the weekly download chart with tracks from “PULSE,” led by title track “With.” Their songs “LOVE ATTACK” and “Deja Vu” also placed third and fifth, respectively, on both the monthly digital and streaming charts.

SHINee’s Onew and Block B’s Zico led the monthly download chart with their collaboration “Tic Tac Toe.” ILLIT, meanwhile, held No. 1 on both the monthly and weekly social charts, with BTS at No. 2 on each.
On the weekly global K-pop chart, ILLIT’s “You’re Under Arrest” rose to No. 2 behind “NEON.” BESTie’s “Love Options” climbed to No. 3, followed by HUNTR/X’s “Golden” and BTS’s “SWIM.”

Yunah, Minju and Wonhee were advised by medical professionals to rest and recover, the agency said in a statement reported by Soompi. Wonhee and Iroha also need ongoing care for ankle injuries.

As a result, BELIFT LAB plans to scale back music show appearances for the group's fifth mini album, along with other promotional activities scheduled for the following week. The agency said the decision was made to prioritize the members' recovery.

ILLIT's participation in the 2026 MAMA AWARDS on November 20 is also under discussion. BELIFT LAB said it would coordinate with the awards organizers and adjust the extent and format of the members' participation according to their health on the day.

The same approach will apply to certain other official activities that had already been confirmed. In its statement, BELIFT LAB acknowledged that fans had been looking forward to the music shows and asked for their understanding. The agency added that it would support the members' recovery.

items.headline: GEHLEE Reaches 2.5 Million Monthly Spotify Listeners as Solo Single Gains Ground
items.dek: The former UNIS member is building a solo audience with “Closer,” which also debuted on the Billboard Philippines Hot 100.
body: GEHLEE has reached 2.5 million monthly Spotify listeners as her debut solo single “Closer” continues to find an audience. Music analytics platform Chartmetric listed the figure in data refreshed on November 17, 2026.

The milestone comes less than a month after the Filipina singer released “Closer” on October 23 under Universal Records Philippines. Monthly listeners measure the size of an artist’s recent audience rather than the total number of plays, and the figure can change from day to day.

The song has also made its mark on the Philippine charts. According to Billboard Philippines, “Closer” debuted at No. 31 on the Philippines Hot 100 dated November 14. GEHLEE co-wrote the lyrics with Artstrong Clarion, who also composed the track.

Known to K-pop fans as Gehlee Dangca, she debuted with fifth-generation girl group UNIS in 2024 after competing on the survival show Universe Ticket. The group concluded its management contract with F&F Entertainment on September 26, 2026, before GEHLEE began her solo chapter in the Philippines.
Alongside her music career, GEHLEE has joined Pinoy Big Brother: Collab Edition 3.0. Billboard Philippines reported that “Closer” is being used to soundtrack her journey on the reality show.

items.headline: RESCENE Leads November Idol Group Brand Reputation Rankings for Third Month
items.dek: BTS and ATEEZ held second and third place, while ILLIT climbed to fourth after a sharp rise in its index.
body: RESCENE has topped the Korean Business Research Institute's idol group brand reputation rankings for the third consecutive month, with BTS and ATEEZ following in second and third place.
The November rankings measure consumer participation, media coverage, interaction and community awareness using data collected from October 18 to November 18, Soompi reported.

RESCENE recorded a brand reputation index of 8,590,984. The group's keyword analysis included “With,” “nation's girl group” and “album,” while related terms included “appear on,” “sold out” and “advertise.” The institute's positivity-negativity analysis found that 97.91 percent of reactions were positive.
BTS remained in second place with an index of 7,169,939. ATEEZ also retained its position in third, scoring 4,521,142, up 13.46 percent from October.
ILLIT rose to fourth with an index of 3,798,014, a 175.54 percent increase from the previous month. IVE rounded out the top five with 3,637,685, an increase of 0.17 percent from October.

body: SBS has unveiled character posters for “Nine to Six,” introducing Park Min Young, BTOB's Yook Sungjae and Go Soo as three colleagues whose lives become intertwined at the office.

The romance follows Kang Yi Ji, a woman who has long focused on proving herself through work. After meeting the warm and thoughtful Han Seon Woo, she begins to reconsider her approach to love and happiness as they grow in their careers and personal lives.

Park Min Young plays Kang Yi Ji, a legal team deputy manager with 10 years of experience. Confident and difficult to shake, she has made work a priority over dating. Her poster captures that attitude with a direct question: “It's not like dating is necessary, is it?”

Yook Sungjae's Han Seon Woo is an intern on the same legal team. While his poster highlights his gentle smile and caring nature, it also hints at his confidence when pursuing someone he likes. Go Soo plays Park Hyun Tae, a cool-headed division head who places a premium on competence.
The three posters set up a contrast between Kang Yi Ji's logic, Han Seon Woo's warmth and Park Hyun Tae's rational outlook, as their characters navigate relationships in the same workplace.

items.dek: The mini album has become TXT's eighth consecutive release to sell more than 1 million copies in its first week.
body: TXT's new mini album “PERFECT STORM” has surpassed 1.5 million sales in its first two days, adding another million-seller to the group's catalog.

According to Hanteo Chart figures reported by Soompi, the album sold 1,534,519 copies by the end of November 17. TXT released “PERFECT STORM” and its title track, “Angel Bite,” on November 16 at 6 p.m. KST.

The result marks the eighth consecutive TXT album to pass the 1 million sales mark during its first week. The run began with “minisode 2: Thursday's Child,” followed by “The Name Chapter: TEMPTATION” and “The Name Chapter: FREEFALL.”
The group's subsequent first-week million-sellers were “minisode 3: TOMORROW,” “The Star Chapter: SANCTUARY,” “The Star Chapter: TOGETHER” and “7TH YEAR: A Moment of Stillness in the Thorns.”
With five days remaining in the album's first sales week after November 17, the total for “PERFECT STORM” could continue to rise through November 22.

items.headline: ILLIT’s ‘BREAK EVEN’ Charts for a Second Week on Billboard 200
items.dek: The mini album is ILLIT’s first to spend multiple weeks on the Billboard 200, while title track “You’re Under Arrest” reaches a new Global 200 peak.
body: ILLIT’s “BREAK EVEN” has become the group’s first album to spend more than one week on the Billboard 200, adding another milestone to its chart run.

The mini album placed No. 44 in its second week, Soompi reported after Billboard revealed the latest rankings on November 17. It had debuted at No. 6 a week earlier, giving ILLIT its first top 20 entry on the albums chart.

“BREAK EVEN” also ranked No. 2 on both the Top Album Sales and World Albums charts after opening at No. 1 on each. Its sales chart position made it the second best-selling album of the week in the United States.

Title track “You’re Under Arrest” continued its run on Billboard’s global charts, reaching a new peak of No. 22 on the Global 200 and placing No. 12 on the Global Excl. U.S. chart. The song was in its third week on both rankings.

ILLIT’s previous title track, “It’s Me,” climbed to No. 102 on the Global Excl. U.S. chart in its 28th week. The group also appeared at No. 58 on the Artist 100, marking its sixth overall week on that chart.

body: Gong Myoung is stepping into the role of a baseball pitcher in MBC's upcoming drama “On Your Ground.” The show's first stills show him in uniform as Kang Hae Hwan, a former prodigy hoping to return to the sport after a career setback.

Kang is a right-handed pitcher for the professional team Miracles who has also played in Major League Baseball. After an unexpected incident threatens his career, he spends two years focused on rehabilitation.

His path changes when he reunites with his first love, Seo Hee Seung, after 11 years. Played by Han Hyo Joo, she is a former lawyer who becomes his sports agent. The romance follows the pair as Kang works toward getting back on the field.

The newly released images show Gong Myoung on the mound in a Miracles uniform, as well as a glimpse of Kang during his earlier success. According to the production team, the actor trained consistently to build a baseball player's physique and learned the fundamentals of a pitcher's stance and movements before filming.

Seo, meanwhile, leaves a successful legal career for a new challenge in sports representation. After training in the United States and qualifying as a sports agent, she joins an agency where she meets Kang again.
“On Your Ground” is scheduled to premiere in December.

items.dek: The upcoming historical drama follows a princess and an escort unit searching for a sacred relic during Goryeo's war with Mongolia.
body: Claudia Kim takes matters into her own hands to save Ahn Bo Hyun in a new teaser for the upcoming JTBC drama “Sacred Jewel,” Soompi reports.

Set in 1258, the series takes place as Goryeo faces possible defeat after around 30 years of war with Mongolia. An escort unit heads into the battlefield to retrieve the Avalokitesvara Bead, a relic believed to have the power to protect the kingdom, while a princess sets out to rescue them.

Kim plays Wang Hee, a princess who has closed herself off after a political marriage and the loss of someone dear to her. Her encounter with young general Baek Gyeol, played by Ahn, begins to change her. The former Gyeonryong Army member understands her feelings, and the pair grow close.

The teaser shows Baek Gyeol volunteering to lead the mission to retrieve the bead. Mongolian forces attack the unit, leaving him wounded by arrows. When Wang Hee hears that the squad has been nearly wiped out, she asks for help getting to Myeongju and sets out to protect him.

Yoon Kyun Sang also appears as Wang Mu, the commander defending Wonju Fortress, whose involvement complicates Wang Hee's journey. Directed by Jung Dae Yoon and written by Jung Hyun Min, “Sacred Jewel” premieres December 5 at 10:40 p.m. KST on JTBC and will stream worldwide on Prime Video.

body: The Traffic Crime Investigation team has a new mystery to unravel in “Crash 2.” Ahead of the second episode, the drama has released stills suggesting that a suspected sudden acceleration accident may be linked to a planned murder.

The first episode ended as Cha Yeon Ho, played by Lee Min Ki, and a junior researcher were about to obtain a crucial piece of evidence. Their car went out of control after someone interfered with it and exploded. In the new images, Yeon Ho and Min So Hee, played by Kwak Sun Young, watch the vehicle burn.
Another set of stills shows So Hee and Woo Dong Gi, played by Lee Ho Chul, reacting to an unexpected discovery. The evidence raises the possibility that the case is more than an accident.

Yeon Ho also appears behind the wheel again, with the junior researcher gripping her seat belt and skilled driver So Hee covering her face. Yeon Ho remains calm in the image, even as his passengers appear alarmed.
The production team said the second episode will reveal clues about the suspected sudden acceleration case as T.C.I. investigates the relationships surrounding it, according to Soompi.

A follow-up to the 2024 drama “Crash,” the series sees the former Namgang Police Station team take on traffic crime cases nationwide as a regional unit under the National Office of Investigation. Episode 2 airs November 17 at 10 p.m. KST.

body: Lee Dong Wook has joined the cast of "Nambeol," an upcoming historical action film led by Lee Byung Hun, Soompi reported on November 17.

Set in the early Joseon dynasty, the film follows nine warriors from different social ranks as they head to Tsushima Island to rescue people abducted by Japanese pirates. Director Lee Mo Gae is helming the project for production company Hive Media Corp.

Lee Dong Wook will play Yoon Gwan, a warrior from Goryeo's Byeolmuban who fights with two swords. Known for his levelheaded judgment and loyalty to his comrades, Yoon Gwan has long stood alongside Im Eok, the group's leader, played by Lee Byung Hun. He joins the mission to bring the captives home.

The previously announced cast also includes Go Youn Jung, Lee Do Hyun, WOODZ, also known as Cho Seung Youn, Park Hae Joon and Lee Kwang Soo. The role of Yoon Gwan was previously offered to Seo Kang Jun, who declined it.
"Nambeol," a literal title, marks another collaboration between Lee Dong Wook and Hive Media Corp following the film "Harbin." The new project is currently in pre-production.

body: Coupang Play's beauty competition “Just Makeup” is returning for a second season with a new five-person hosting lineup. Girls' Generation's Taeyeon and Lim Yoona, aespa's Winter, comedian Jang Do Yeon and TWICE's Nayeon will lead the show.

The production team announced the return on November 17, releasing individual posters and a teaser featuring the hosts, according to Soompi. “Just Makeup 2” will premiere on November 27 at 5 p.m. KST.

The survival series brings K-beauty makeup artists together to compete through their skills, techniques and creative approaches. Season 2 will feature 60 contestants and four judges, who will evaluate their work, alongside the five hosts.

The new posters pair each host with a makeup tool, with the show's signature pink brush appearing alongside items including mascara, lipstick, a pencil, a makeup puff and eyeliner. The teaser brings all five hosts together ahead of the season's premiere.

The hosts will take part in the competition process, bringing their perspectives and interest in makeup and the artists behind it to the show. The second season will continue the competitive format of the first while introducing the new MC team.

items.dek: New images from the romance drama tease a shift between Kwon Do Hyuk and Lee Eun Chae as Moon Tae Kyung grows closer to her.
body: Sung Hoon and Oh Se Young's characters are closer than usual in new stills from “What a Boss Wants,” with the frequently bickering boss and secretary pictured lying side by side in bed.

The images show Lee Eun Chae (Oh Se Young) watching a drunken, sleeping Kwon Do Hyuk (Sung Hoon) before cautiously reaching toward his face. The moment comes after the pair agreed to a three-month contract as CEO and secretary, insisting they would not develop romantic feelings for each other.

Based on a web novel, the drama follows chaebol boss Do Hyuk as he searches for a mysterious woman whose voice he heard on an album. Eun Chae is the lead vocalist of indie band India Red, where she performs under the name Soo.

Their working relationship has already faced complications. When office duties interfered with Eun Chae's band activities, she went to a concert venue and received help from Moon Tae Kyung (Lee Jung Shin). Do Hyuk later threw away a bouquet Tae Kyung had given her, sparking another argument.
Tae Kyung, meanwhile, has learned Eun Chae's musical identity and promised to keep it secret. He also tells her he will bring flowers to her next performance.

Do Hyuk faces another test when he overhears Eun Chae planning to stay at the home of her bandmate Kim Dong Woo (Yoo Shin), after growing frustrated with her father's strict curfew. Episode 3 airs on November 18 at 10:20 p.m. KST.

items.headline: Jang Sung Kyu, Sooyoung and Moon Sang Min to Host 2026 KBS Drama Awards
items.dek: The December 31 live broadcast will bring two returning hosts together with first-time KBS Drama Awards MC Sooyoung.
body: Jang Sung Kyu, Sooyoung and Moon Sang Min will host the 2026 KBS Drama Awards, KBS announced on November 17. The ceremony will air live on December 31, according to Soompi.

Jang and Moon are returning to the hosting lineup, while Sooyoung, also known as Choi Soo Young, joins them for the first time. The ceremony will look back on KBS dramas and the actors who appeared in them over the year, with works ranging from historical dramas and miniseries to weekend, daily and single-episode dramas.
For Jang, the event marks a fourth consecutive year as a KBS Drama Awards host, a run that began in 2023. He has also worked as an MC across variety, current affairs and educational programs.

Sooyoung appeared this year in the film "OK! Madam: Bon Voyage" and the play "The Merchant of Venice." She is also set to star in the KBS2 weekend drama "I Went to School," a literal title, which is scheduled to air in 2027.

Moon will host the ceremony for the third consecutive year. He starred in the KBS2 drama "To My Beloved Thief" this year, playing dual roles alongside Nam Ji Hyun, who co-hosted the 2025 KBS Drama Awards.

items.headline: YG Entertainment says BLACKPINK group activity talks are ongoing
items.dek: The agency responded after BLACKPINK was absent from the exclusive contract list in its latest quarterly report.
body: YG Entertainment says discussions about BLACKPINK's group activities are ongoing after the group was left off the agency's latest list of artists under exclusive contracts.

The third-quarter report, released on November 16, listed BABYMONSTER, WINNER, Eun Ji Won and TREASURE under its exclusive contract section. BLACKPINK had appeared alongside those acts in the preceding semiannual report.

The omission prompted questions about the status of the group's agreement with YG. All four members, Jisoo, Jennie, Rosé and Lisa, renewed their contracts with the agency for group activities in December 2023. BLACKPINK had appeared in every regular report from the 2023 annual report through the latest semiannual report.

YG told Soompi that the members are currently pursuing individual activities while talks about group activities continue. The agency said it respects their wishes to focus on individual work for the time being and will continue discussions about BLACKPINK's future performances as a group.

In December 2023, YG also announced that it would not sign separate contracts for the members' individual activities. The latest quarterly report continued to identify BLACKPINK among the intellectual properties associated with YG's music, photo book and merchandise business.

Released on October 15, 2025, the video took approximately one year, one month and one day to reach the milestone. P NATION also celebrated the achievement in a social media post, sharing a link to the video.

“Good Goodbye” is Hwasa's second solo music video to surpass 200 million views, following “Maria.” The earlier video reached the same mark in approximately one year and 29 days, a similar stretch of time to “Good Goodbye.”
The milestone adds to Hwasa's YouTube achievements as a solo artist alongside her work with MAMAMOO. Fans can revisit “Good Goodbye” on YouTube.

items.dek: The upcoming romance follows a former lawyer and a baseball player who reunite 11 years after their first love.
body: Han Hyo Joo is heading into the world of baseball in MBC's upcoming drama “Your Ground,” with newly released stills offering a look at her character's career change.

The actor plays Seo Hee Seung, a former attorney at a major law firm who becomes a sports agent. The romance follows her reunion with Kang Hae Hwan, played by Gong Myoung, a baseball player whose career has stalled after a setback. With Hee Seung as his agent, he sets out to return to the field.

As Soompi reports, Hee Seung was a top student who never lost a case in court. After training in the United States and earning a sports agent license, she joins the agency Donghaeng at the request of Joy Law Firm representative Jo Gu Yeon, played by Cho Han Cheul.
The new images contrast her two professional lives. In one, she wears a black suit and looks directly ahead as an attorney. In another, she appears more relaxed and smiles after joining the agency.

Though confident in legal work, Hee Seung is new to professional baseball. She will draw on her judgment and negotiation skills as she learns to work with athletes. Her partnership with Hae Hwan also brings a personal history: the two were each other's first love and meet again after 11 years.
“Your Ground” is scheduled to premiere on MBC in December.

body: Lee Joon Gi and Sakaguchi Kentaro's characters are headed for a clash as a new round of the survival game begins in Channel A's thriller “kiDnap GAME.”
The series follows seven people assigned separate missions in a kidnapping case spanning seven Asian cities. Each must complete their task ahead of the others to protect their loved ones and survive.

Sakaguchi plays Tokyo detective Niide Toshiro, who joined forces with Seoul doctor Han Ki Joo, played by Lee, after stopping him from taking his own life. Ki Joo has placed some faith in the detective's promise to save everyone, but has also warned him against betrayal.

In the episode 7 preview, the five remaining participants meet by video conference on the kidnapper's orders. Each receives a vote in an elimination game. Although cooperation could allow everyone to survive, fear of betrayal leads participants to nominate one another.

The arrival of Andy Wong, a Hong Kong international lawyer played by Stanley Yau, adds another complication. In a private meeting with Niide and Ki Joo, Andy proposes eliminating Naha participant Higa Kuranosuke, played by Mitsushima Shinnosuke. Niide agrees, prompting an angry response from Ki Joo.
Episode 7 of “kiDnap GAME” is scheduled to air on November 17 at 10 p.m. KST.
